content: Zendesk Agent Workspace dark mode: default-on admin setting; agent chooses Light/Dark/Match system appearance in profile Appearance; switch applies immediately without reload; covers tickets and views; dark surface ~#151A1E, text ~#D8DCDE (internalnote 2025-03). ZAF apps get colorScheme light|dark and colorScheme.changed event, but content scripts cannot use ZAF; no documented DOM attribute for the host scheme - must be found by live recon. Garden react-theming ColorSchemeProvider persists light/dark/system.
